item.title: Zotac warns memory crisis poses an existential threat to graphics card makers
item.description: A recent memo from Zotac's South Korean division, translated by prominent leaker @harukaze5719, states that GPUs will become more expensive and difficult to obtain in 2026 and potentially beyond. As Asus and other manufacturers begin raising prices, Zotac does not currently see a light at the end of the tunnel.Read Entire Article

item.title: Android 17 leak reveals a translucent design similar to Apple's Liquid Glass UI
item.description: Tipster MysticLeaks recently posted – and later deleted – a series of screenshots on Telegram that appear to show background blur effects applied across much of Android 17, echoing Apple's Liquid Glass UI in iOS 26.Read Entire Article

item.title: Transmission torrent client just got a major performance upgrade
item.description: After an extensive beta period, Transmission 4.10 improves torrent download performance, expands IPv6 support, and reduces CPU usage. It also includes dozens of refinements across all platforms, keeping the client lightweight, and reliable as longtime users often put it.Read Entire Article

item.title: After 70 years of false starts, fusion energy is finally gaining momentum
item.description: The machines at their center, called tokamaks, have evolved from experimental curiosities into instruments capable of sustaining confined plasma – matter so hot it mimics the interior of stars – for record periods of time.Read Entire Article

item.title: Crypto laundering surged to $82 billion last year and the numbers keep rising
item.description: The data represents a staggering leap from 2020, when illicit crypto laundering totaled just $10 billion globally. By contrast, last year's total reached $82 billion, driven largely by the rise of specialized Chinese-language "guarantee platforms" and related laundering services operating across Telegram, payment processors, and over-the-counter markets.Read Entire Article

item.title: Neural network detects 800+ rare cosmic phenomena in historical Hubble archives
item.description: A study demonstrates that AI can be harnessed for scientific discovery. The neural network in question, named AnomalyMatch, was used to detect hundreds of previously unknown anomalies in our local universe. Researchers first tested it on the historical Hubble dataset, but the AI is expected to reveal even more cosmic...Read Entire Article

item.title: Screenshot utility ShareX adds AI image analysis
item.description: ShareX is a popular Windows utility for screenshot capture and screen recording. Version 19.0 introduces a new AI analyze image tool with support for GPT and Gemini. The update also upgrades to FFmpeg 8.0.Read Entire Article

item.title: ASML slashes 1,700 jobs even as demand for chipmaking machines hits record highs
item.description: CEO Christophe Fouquet framed the restructuring as an effort to make ASML more agile. Roughly four percent of the company's global workforce – about 1,700 positions – will be cut, primarily affecting managerial and support roles in the Netherlands, with smaller reductions in the US.Read Entire Article
